title: Cancel four strong dipoles
hints: Look for equivalent bonds in a symmetric arrangement.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: In $\ce{CF4}$ all four equivalent C–F bond vectors cancel by tetrahedral symmetry.
statement:
Which of the following molecules is nonpolar?

[_]{a}

explanations: The four equivalent dipoles sum to zero.
The terminal bonds differ, leaving a net dipole.
The bent F–O–F arrangement leaves a net dipole.
The trigonal pyramid has a net dipole.
